== Summary ==
[[Michael Pistone]] (left, blue #18 jersey; matches [[:File:Michael Pistone 2008 Match Play Championship.jpg]]) and [[Brad Eier]] (right, green "TEAM OHIO" T-shirt; matches [[:File:Brad Eier 2007 World Championship.jpg]]) in the first final-four game of the [[2007 Match Play Championship]], January 2007 (poster's file name "Pistone and Eier final four game 1").

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by Aglets: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=193822#p193822 post 193822], "Pictures, Pictures, and more Pictures from the MPC" (topic 13762), 27 January 2007. Photobucket album MKole, image PistoneandEierfinalfourgame1.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005909/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t13762.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/8e/Michael_Pistone_and_Brad_Eier_2007_Match_Play_Championship_final_four_game.jpg Internet Archive item].
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261126050004/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/8/8e/Michael_Pistone_and_Brad_Eier_2007_Match_Play_Championship_final_four_game.jpg Internet Archive].
